title: OpenAI makes a new, large Azure commitment as Stargate launches

sources.quote: In addition to this, OpenAI recently made a new, large Azure commitment that will continue to support all OpenAI products as well as training.

explain: When OpenAI announced its Stargate data-center project in January 2025, Microsoft said OpenAI had also signed a new, large commitment to keep buying Azure cloud computing. No amount was given.
